about.subtitle: Technology · Entrepreneurship · Cybersecurity · Marketing
paragraphs: I'm Vishwa Kumar (also known as Vishwa K), Founder & CEO at Zinoin Group, established in August 2025. Based in Bangalore, India, I deliver specialized cybersecurity engineering, network defense architectures, full-stack software systems, and performance digital marketing to clients and organizations worldwide.

With 1.5 years of hands-on experience, I bridge the gap between commercial business objectives and robust technical implementation. My work spans architecting enterprise AI retrieval platforms (DocuMind AI), engineering secure transaction ordering systems, and executing high-ROI digital acquisition campaigns.
Currently pursuing my B.E. in Cybersecurity Engineering at Sri Sai Ranganathan Engineering College (CGPA: 8.5/10), I combine rigorous computer science fundamentals with commercial venture operations.
From Bangalore to global markets, I engineer resilient digital infrastructure, enforce strict cybersecurity hygiene, and build scalable systems that deliver measurable commercial value.
